title: First Moon Landing
description: Apollo 11 successfully landed humans on the Moon, marking humanity's first crewed landing on another celestial body.

title: India Gains Independence
description: India became an independent nation after British rule, beginning a new chapter in the country's modern history.

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
description: The Berlin Wall was opened, leading to the reunification of Germany and signaling the end of the Cold War.

title: First Airplane Flight
description: The Wright brothers successfully flew the first powered, controlled, and sustained heavier-than-air aircraft.

title: Sinking of the Titanic
description: The RMS Titanic sank in the North Atlantic Ocean after striking an iceberg during her maiden voyage.

title: First iPhone Released
description: Apple released the first generation iPhone, revolutionizing the smartphone industry and mobile computing.

title: United Nations Founded
description: The United Nations Charter entered into force, formally creating the international organization to promote peace.

title: Discovery of Penicillin
description: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin, the world's first widely effective antibiotic, transforming modern medicine.

title: Magna Carta Sealed
description: King John of England sealed the Magna Carta, establishing the principle that everyone is subject to the law.

title: First Human Heart Transplant
description: Dr. Christiaan Barnard performed the world's first successful human-to-human heart transplant in South Africa.

title: Chernobyl Nuclear Disaster
description: A reactor exploded at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, causing the worst nuclear disaster in history.

title: September 11 Attacks
description: Terrorists hijacked four commercial airplanes, carrying out coordinated attacks against the United States.

title: First Harry Potter Book
description: J.K. Rowling published Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, launching a massive global cultural phenomenon.

title: Discovery of Pluto
description: Astronomer Clyde Tombaugh discovered Pluto, which was considered the ninth planet of the solar system for decades.

title: First YouTube Video
description: Jawed Karim uploaded 'Me at the zoo', the very first video on the YouTube platform.

title: First Modern Olympics
description: The first international Olympic Games held in modern history opened in Athens, Greece.

title: Chandrayaan-3 Moon Landing
description: India's Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed near the lunar south pole, making India the first nation to achieve this.

title: India Wins 1983 World Cup
description: The Indian cricket team, led by Kapil Dev, won their first Cricket World Cup, defeating the West Indies.

title: Tata Airlines Founded
description: J.R.D. Tata founded Tata Airlines, which would later become Air India, pioneering civil aviation in India.

title: Bombay Stock Exchange Founded
description: The Bombay Stock Exchange was established, becoming the first and oldest corporate stock exchange in Asia.

title: World War II Begins
description: Germany invaded Poland, prompting Britain and France to declare war and officially beginning World War II.

title: James Webb Telescope Launched
description: NASA successfully launched the James Webb Space Telescope to conduct unprecedented infrared astronomy.

title: Archduke Franz Ferdinand Assassinated
description: Gavrilo Princip assassinated Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo, the spark that ignited World War I.

title: First Ascent of Mount Everest
description: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first confirmed climbers to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: First Star Wars Film
description: George Lucas released the original Star Wars film, forever changing blockbuster cinema and pop culture.

title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
description: The Imperial Japanese Navy launched a surprise military strike against the United States naval base at Pearl Harbor.

title: Bitcoin Network Launched
description: Satoshi Nakamoto mined the genesis block of Bitcoin, officially launching the first decentralized cryptocurrency.

title: First Apple Mac Released
description: Apple introduced the original Macintosh computer, featuring a revolutionary graphical user interface and mouse.

title: DNA Structure Published
description: James Watson and Francis Crick published their groundbreaking scientific paper describing the double helix structure of DNA.

title: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius
description: Mount Vesuvius catastrophically erupted, burying the Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum in volcanic ash.

title: First Color TV Broadcast
description: CBS broadcast the world's first commercial color television program to a limited audience across the United States.

title: US Declaration of Independence
description: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence, severing political ties with Great Britain.

title: First Mammal Cloned
description: Scientists successfully cloned Dolly the sheep, the first mammal cloned from an adult somatic cell.

title: Indian Constitution Effect
description: The Constitution of India formally came into effect, establishing the nation as a sovereign democratic republic.

title: Launch of Mangalyaan
description: The Indian Space Research Organisation launched the Mars Orbiter Mission, India's first interplanetary expedition.

title: Battle of Plassey
description: The British East India Company achieved a decisive victory over the Nawab of Bengal, securing British rule in India.

title: First Passenger Train in India
description: India's first commercial passenger train travelled from Bori Bunder in Bombay to Thane, covering 34 kilometers.

title: Tagore Wins Nobel Prize
description: Rabindranath Tagore was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, becoming the first non-European to win the honor.

title: Abolition of Sati Practice
description: The Bengal Sati Regulation was passed under Lord William Bentinck, formally banning the practice of Sati in India.

title: Formation of Telangana
description: Telangana was officially separated from Andhra Pradesh to become the 29th state of the Republic of India.

title: French Revolution Begins
description: A revolutionary mob stormed the Bastille prison in Paris, igniting the French Revolution and ending absolute monarchy.

title: Launch of Sputnik 1
description: The Soviet Union successfully launched Sputnik 1, the world's first artificial Earth satellite, initiating the Space Race.

title: First MTV Broadcast
description: MTV launched its television network with the broadcast of the music video 'Video Killed the Radio Star'.

title: Sinking of the Lusitania
description: A German U-boat torpedoed and sank the RMS Lusitania, shifting American public opinion toward joining World War I.

title: Apple Inc Founded
description: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne founded Apple Computer Company to develop and sell personal computers.

title: First Polio Vaccine Announced
description: Medical researcher Jonas Salk announced the successful development of the first effective vaccine against polio.

title: Origin of Species Published
description: Charles Darwin published 'On the Origin of Species', introducing the scientific theory of evolution by natural selection.

title: Hindenburg Disaster
description: The LZ 129 Hindenburg airship caught fire and was destroyed while attempting to dock in New Jersey.

title: Nintendo Founded
description: Fusajiro Yamauchi founded Nintendo in Kyoto, Japan, initially to produce handmade hanafuda playing cards.

title: First Woman in Space
description: Soviet cosmonaut Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman to travel into space aboard the Vostok 6 mission.

title: Rosa Parks Bus Boycott
description: Rosa Parks refused to surrender her bus seat to a white passenger, sparking the Montgomery bus boycott.

title: Discovery of X-Rays
description: Physicist Wilhelm Röntgen accidentally discovered X-rays while experimenting with electrical currents through glass cathode-ray tubes.

title: Opening of the Panama Canal
description: The Panama Canal officially opened for ship traffic, revolutionizing international maritime trade routes.

title: First Web Page Published
description: Tim Berners-Lee published the world's very first website, hosting information about the World Wide Web project.

title: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
description: British colonial troops opened fire on a large crowd of unarmed Indian civilians gathering peacefully in Amritsar.

title: Launch of Aryabhata
description: India successfully launched Aryabhata, its first domestically built satellite, utilizing a Soviet Kosmos-3M launch vehicle.

title: Pokhran-II Nuclear Tests
description: India successfully conducted a series of five nuclear bomb test explosions at the Indian Army's Pokhran Test Range.

title: Mother Teresa Wins Nobel
description: Mother Teresa was officially awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her extensive humanitarian work in Calcutta.

title: Indian Rupee Symbol Introduced
description: The Government of India officially approved and introduced the new currency symbol for the Indian Rupee.

title: Indian National Congress Formed
description: The Indian National Congress held its first session in Bombay, becoming a pivotal organization in the independence movement.

title: Concorde Commercial Flight
description: The supersonic passenger airliner Concorde completed its first scheduled commercial flights for British Airways and Air France.

title: Eiffel Tower Completed
description: Construction of the iconic Eiffel Tower was officially completed in Paris ahead of the 1889 World's Fair.

title: Abraham Lincoln Assassinated
description: John Wilkes Booth fatally shot U.S. President Abraham Lincoln while he was attending a play at Ford's Theatre.

title: First ARPANET Message
description: Researchers sent the first computer-to-computer message over ARPANET, the technological precursor to the modern Internet.

title: Tutankhamun Tomb Discovered
description: British archaeologist Howard Carter discovered the steps leading down to the miraculously intact tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun.

title: Hubble Telescope Launched
description: The Space Shuttle Discovery successfully deployed the Hubble Space Telescope into low Earth orbit.

title: Fall of Constantinople
description: The Ottoman Empire captured the capital of the Byzantine Empire, permanently altering the balance of global power.

title: First Successful Vaccine
description: Edward Jenner administered the world's first successful vaccine, inoculating a young boy against smallpox.

title: First Sony PlayStation
description: Sony released the original PlayStation console in Japan, revolutionizing the global video game industry.

title: Cuban Missile Crisis
description: U.S. leadership learned of Soviet ballistic missiles stationed in Cuba, initiating a tense 13-day nuclear standoff.

title: Rosetta Stone Discovered
description: French soldiers in Egypt discovered the Rosetta Stone, which ultimately provided the key to deciphering ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.

title: Communist Manifesto Published
description: Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels published their influential political pamphlet outlining the theories of communism.

title: First Ascent of K2
description: An Italian expedition successfully completed the very first ascent of K2, the world's second-highest mountain.

title: Super Mario Bros Released
description: Nintendo released Super Mario Bros for the Famicom console, pioneering the side-scrolling platform video game genre.

title: Dandi March Begins
description: Mahatma Gandhi initiated the Salt March, a massive act of nonviolent civil disobedience against British colonial salt laws.

title: Launch of Chandrayaan-1
description: ISRO successfully launched Chandrayaan-1, India's first deep space mission to orbit and study the Moon.

title: Abhinav Bindra Wins Gold
description: Abhinav Bindra won gold in the 10m Air Rifle event, securing India's first-ever individual Olympic gold medal.

title: Vasco da Gama in Calicut
description: Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama reached Calicut, India, successfully establishing the first direct sea route from Europe to Asia.

title: State Bank of India Formed
description: The Imperial Bank of India was formally nationalized and renamed as the State Bank of India.

title: Premiere of Sholay
description: The iconic Bollywood film 'Sholay' premiered in theaters, going on to become a cultural milestone in Indian cinema.

title: First Artificial Heart
description: Surgeons implanted the Jarvik-7, the first permanent artificial human heart, into patient Barney Clark.

title: Soviet Union Dissolution
description: The Soviet Union was officially dissolved, ending the Cold War and establishing multiple independent republics.

title: Invention of the Telephone
description: Alexander Graham Bell successfully made the first two-way transmission of clear speech over a telephone line.

title: Nelson Mandela Elected
description: Nelson Mandela was officially sworn in as the first black president of a democratic South Africa.

title: First Wikipedia Edit
description: Jimmy Wales made the very first edit to Wikipedia, officially launching the free online encyclopedia.

title: Launch of Voyager 1
description: NASA launched the Voyager 1 space probe to study the outer Solar System and eventually enter interstellar space.

title: MLK Jr Assassinated
description: Civil rights leader Martin Luther King Jr. was tragically assassinated on the balcony of his motel in Memphis.

title: Transcontinental Railroad Done
description: The First Transcontinental Railroad across the United States was completed with the ceremonial driving of the Golden Spike.

title: Cosmic Microwave Background
description: Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson published their discovery of cosmic microwave background radiation, proving the Big Bang theory.

title: Euro Currency Introduction
description: The Euro was officially introduced as an accounting currency by the European Union, merging several national economies.

title: First Live TV Broadcast
description: Scottish inventor John Logie Baird successfully transmitted the first live television pictures in his London laboratory.

title: Anne Frank Diary Published
description: The deeply personal wartime diary of Jewish teenager Anne Frank was published posthumously in the Netherlands.

title: Sinking of the Bismarck
description: The formidable German battleship Bismarck was finally sunk by British naval forces in the North Atlantic.

title: Apartheid Laws Repealed
description: The South African parliament overwhelmingly voted to repeal the legal framework that had enforced institutional racial segregation.

title: India Adopts National Flag
description: The Constituent Assembly formally adopted the Tiranga (Tricolor) as the official national flag of an independent India.

title: Launch of INS Arihant
description: India successfully launched INS Arihant, becoming the sixth nation capable of building and operating nuclear-powered submarines.

title: First India Test Match
description: The Indian national cricket team played its very first official Test match against England at Lord's.

title: Amartya Sen Wins Nobel
description: Indian economist Amartya Sen was awarded the Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for his work in welfare economics.

title: New Delhi Inaugurated
description: New Delhi was officially inaugurated as the new capital of British India, shifting power away from Calcutta.

title: Implementation of GST
description: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was enacted, representing India's most significant tax reform since independence.

title: Hiroshima Atomic Bomb
description: The United States dropped the first atomic bomb, codenamed 'Little Boy', on the Japanese city of Hiroshima.

title: Discovery of Radium
description: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered the radioactive element radium, fundamentally changing the scientific understanding of atomic physics.

title: First SMS Text Message
description: Engineer Neil Papworth sent the world's first SMS text message, reading 'Merry Christmas', to a Vodafone director.

title: First Academy Awards
description: The first Academy Awards ceremony was held at the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel, honoring the best in film.

title: ISS First Module Launched
description: The Zarya module was launched into orbit, becoming the first foundational component of the International Space Station.

title: Partition of India Announced
description: Lord Mountbatten formally announced the plan to partition British India into the independent dominions of India and Pakistan.

title: First Indian in Space
description: Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian citizen to travel into space aboard the Soviet Union's Soyuz T-11.

title: Suez Canal Opens
description: The Suez Canal was officially opened to navigation, connecting the Mediterranean Sea directly to the Red Sea.

title: Usain Bolt 100m Record
description: Jamaican sprinter Usain Bolt set a staggering new world record of 9.58 seconds in the 100-meter dash.

title: Lord of the Rings Published
description: The Fellowship of the Ring, the first volume of J.R.R. Tolkien's epic fantasy masterpiece, was published.

title: Execution of Louis XVI
description: King Louis XVI of France was executed by guillotine in Paris during the height of the French Revolution.

title: Windows 95 Released
description: Microsoft released Windows 95 to immense fanfare, introducing the Start button and modern graphical desktop computing.

title: Mahatma Gandhi Assassinated
description: Mahatma Gandhi, the preeminent leader of Indian independence, was tragically assassinated by Nathuram Godse in New Delhi.

title: Launch of Aadhaar
description: The first Aadhaar number was successfully issued in Maharashtra, inaugurating the world's largest biometric ID system.

title: Neeraj Chopra Olympic Gold
description: Javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra won gold in Tokyo, becoming the first Indian track and field athlete to win Olympic gold.

title: General Relativity Published
description: Albert Einstein presented his groundbreaking field equations of general relativity to the Prussian Academy of Sciences.

title: Sydney Opera House Opens
description: Queen Elizabeth II officially opened the Sydney Opera House, a masterpiece of modern 20th-century architecture.

title: Fukushima Nuclear Disaster
description: A massive earthquake and tsunami triggered a catastrophic nuclear meltdown at the Fukushima Daiichi power plant in Japan.

title: Jurassic Park Premiere
description: Steven Spielberg's Jurassic Park premiered, pioneering groundbreaking computer-generated imagery that transformed the global film industry.

title: First Kidney Transplant
description: Surgeons in Boston performed the world's first successful living-donor kidney transplant between identical twin brothers.

title: Assassination of JFK
description: U.S. President John F. Kennedy was tragically assassinated while riding in a presidential motorcade through Dallas, Texas.

title: Discovery of the Electron
description: Physicist J.J. Thomson announced the discovery of the electron, identifying the first subatomic particle in history.

title: Apollo 13 Launched
description: NASA launched the Apollo 13 mission, which famously suffered a catastrophic oxygen tank explosion days later.

title: Google Incorporated
description: Larry Page and Sergey Brin formally incorporated Google as a privately held company in a California garage.

title: Battle of Buxar
description: The British East India Company decisively defeated allied Indian forces, cementing British territorial control over Bengal.

title: Raman Effect Discovered
description: Indian physicist C.V. Raman discovered the inelastic scattering of light, later earning him the Nobel Prize in Physics.

title: Air India Nationalized
description: The Government of India officially nationalized the aviation industry, integrating multiple airlines into Indian Airlines and Air India.

title: First Indian Feature Film
description: Dadasaheb Phalke's 'Raja Harishchandra', the first full-length Indian feature film, was publicly released in Bombay.

title: Mary Kom Olympic Bronze
description: Indian boxer Mary Kom won the bronze medal in the inaugural women's flyweight event at the London Olympics.

title: Discovery of Antarctica
description: A Russian expedition led by Fabian Gottlieb von Bellingshausen recorded the very first confirmed sighting of the Antarctic continent.

title: Mandela Released
description: Anti-apartheid activist Nelson Mandela was officially released from Victor Verster Prison after 27 years of incarceration.

title: Statue of Liberty Dedicated
description: The Statue of Liberty, a gift from the people of France, was officially dedicated in New York Harbor.

title: Shakespeare First Folio
description: The First Folio, the first published collection of William Shakespeare's brilliant theatrical plays, was entered into the Stationers' Register.

title: Beatles on Ed Sullivan
description: The Beatles made their record-breaking first live television appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show in the United States.

title: First FIFA World Cup Final
description: Uruguay defeated Argentina 4-2 to win the inaugural FIFA World Cup tournament held in Montevideo.

title: Discovery of Insulin
description: Researchers Frederick Banting and Charles Best successfully isolated insulin, paving the way for life-saving diabetes treatments.

title: Krakatoa Eruption Climax
description: The Indonesian volcano Krakatoa reached its cataclysmic climax, generating the loudest sound ever historically recorded on Earth.

title: Warsaw Pact Signed
description: The Soviet Union and seven Eastern Bloc nations signed the Warsaw Pact, forming a mutual defense treaty.

title: Launch of Facebook
description: Mark Zuckerberg and his college roommates officially launched 'TheFacebook' from their Harvard University dormitory room.

title: Fall of the Roman Empire
description: Odoacer deposed the young Emperor Romulus Augustulus, marking the traditional end of the Western Roman Empire.

title: Treaty of Versailles Signed
description: The Treaty of Versailles was officially signed, imposing strict terms on Germany and ending World War I.

title: Newton Publishes Principia
description: Isaac Newton published 'Principia Mathematica', formulating the laws of motion and universal gravitation that defined classical mechanics.

title: First Human in Space
description: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin became the first human being to travel into space, completing one orbit of Earth.

title: Web Opens to Public
description: Tim Berners-Lee opened the World Wide Web project to the public, transforming how global information is shared.

title: Sepoy Mutiny Begins
description: Indian soldiers in Meerut rebelled against the British East India Company, sparking the First War of Indian Independence.

title: Indira Gandhi Assassinated
description: Indian Prime Minister Indira Gandhi was tragically assassinated by two of her bodyguards in the garden of her residence.

title: UPI Launched in India
description: The National Payments Corporation of India successfully launched the Unified Payments Interface, revolutionizing digital transactions across the nation.

title: First Indian Antarctic Expedition
description: The very first Indian scientific expedition to Antarctica successfully landed, beginning India's permanent presence on the frozen continent.

title: Satyajit Ray Honorary Oscar
description: Legendary Indian filmmaker Satyajit Ray was awarded an Honorary Academy Award for his profound contributions to global cinema.

title: Snow White Premiere
description: Walt Disney's 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs', the world's first full-length cel-animated feature film, premiered.

title: First Multiracial Elections
description: South Africa held its very first democratic multiracial elections, marking the official end of the apartheid regime.

title: Four-Minute Mile Broken
description: British runner Roger Bannister achieved the seemingly impossible by running a mile in under four minutes.

title: Trans-Siberian Railway Completed
description: The Khabarovsk Bridge over the Amur River opened, completing the final link of the monumental Trans-Siberian Railway.

title: Frankenstein Published
description: Mary Shelley anonymously published her pioneering gothic science fiction novel 'Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus'.

title: WHO Founded
description: The Constitution of the World Health Organization came into force, establishing a global agency focused on public health.

title: Thriller Album Released
description: Michael Jackson released 'Thriller', which went on to become the best-selling music album of all time.

title: Tunguska Event
description: A massive, mysterious mid-air explosion flattened roughly 2,000 square kilometers of remote forest in Siberia, Russia.

title: Burj Khalifa Opens
description: The Burj Khalifa officially opened in Dubai, claiming the title of the tallest human-made structure in the world.

title: Sony Walkman Released
description: Sony revolutionized the portable music industry by releasing the first generation of the Walkman cassette player.

title: D-Day Landings
description: Allied forces launched a massive amphibious invasion on the beaches of Normandy, beginning the liberation of Western Europe.

title: Nagasaki Atomic Bomb
description: The United States dropped a second atomic bomb, codenamed 'Fat Man', on the Japanese city of Nagasaki.

title: Discovery of the Neutron
description: Physicist James Chadwick published his discovery of the neutron, a heavy, uncharged subatomic particle within the atomic nucleus.

title: Challenger Disaster
description: The NASA Space Shuttle Challenger tragically broke apart 73 seconds into its flight, killing all seven crew members.

title: First Commercial Cell Call
description: The first commercial cellular telephone network, Ameritech Mobile Communications, launched successfully in Chicago with a historic call.

title: Quit India Movement Launched
description: Mahatma Gandhi launched the Quit India Movement at the Gowalia Tank Maidan, demanding an immediate end to British rule.

title: Launch of Astrosat
description: ISRO successfully launched Astrosat, India's very first dedicated multi-wavelength space observatory into Earth's orbit.

title: PV Sindhu World Champion
description: P.V. Sindhu secured a historic victory in Basel to become the first Indian to win the Badminton World Championships.

title: Arundhati Roy Wins Booker
description: Arundhati Roy became the first resident Indian citizen to win the prestigious Booker Prize for 'The God of Small Things'.

title: RTI Act Enforcement
description: India's landmark Right to Information (RTI) Act formally came into force, granting citizens profound access to government records.

title: The Matrix Released
description: The groundbreaking science fiction action film 'The Matrix' was released, heavily influencing cyberpunk culture and visual effects.

title: Rwandan Genocide Begins
description: The tragic and systematic genocide against the Tutsi population commenced in Rwanda, resulting in catastrophic loss of life.

title: Smallpox Eradicated
description: The World Health Assembly officially declared the global eradication of smallpox, one of humanity's deadliest viral diseases.

title: Mount St. Helens Eruption
description: Mount St. Helens catastrophically erupted in Washington state, producing the most destructive volcanic event in U.S. history.

title: Woodstock Festival Begins
description: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair opened in upstate New York, becoming a pivotal moment in popular culture.

title: Amazon Founded
description: Jeff Bezos officially founded Amazon in his garage, initially launching it as an online marketplace for books.

title: Channel Tunnel Opens
description: The Channel Tunnel, an unprecedented engineering marvel connecting the United Kingdom and France by rail, was officially opened.

title: First Winter Olympics
description: The first modern Winter Olympic Games officially commenced in the scenic alpine resort town of Chamonix, France.

title: 1984 Novel Published
description: George Orwell published his seminal dystopian novel '1984', introducing enduring concepts like Big Brother and Thought Police.

title: NES Launched in America
description: Nintendo released the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) in North America, successfully revitalizing the home video game industry.

title: Bolshevik Revolution Begins
description: Vladimir Lenin and the Bolsheviks launched a near-bloodless coup d'etat against the Russian Provisional Government in Petrograd.

title: US Constitution Signed
description: Delegates at the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia formally signed the United States Constitution, establishing the national government.

title: Higgs Boson Announced
description: CERN scientists announced the monumental discovery of a particle matching the elusive Higgs boson at the Large Hadron Collider.

title: Curiosity Rover Launched
description: NASA launched the highly advanced Curiosity rover on a mission to determine if Mars ever supported microbial life.

title: Spotify Launched
description: The Spotify music streaming platform was officially launched in Europe, radically shifting how consumers access and listen to music.

title: Goa Liberated
description: The Indian Armed Forces successfully ended over 450 years of Portuguese colonial rule in Goa through Operation Vijay.

title: APJ Kalam Becomes President
description: Distinguished aerospace scientist A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was formally sworn in as the 11th President of the Republic of India.

title: LIC Formation
description: The Parliament of India passed the Life Insurance of India Act, nationalizing private insurance companies into the LIC.

title: International Yoga Day
description: The United Nations General Assembly officially adopted a resolution designating June 21 as the International Day of Yoga.

title: Anand World Chess Champion
description: Indian grandmaster Viswanathan Anand won the FIDE World Chess Championship in Tehran, becoming a global chess icon.

title: Toy Story Premiere
description: Pixar released 'Toy Story', which made cinematic history as the very first entirely computer-animated feature-length film.

title: Fall of Saddam Statue
description: U.S. forces and Iraqi civilians toppled the massive bronze statue of Saddam Hussein in Baghdad's Firdos Square.

title: DNA Fingerprinting Discovered
description: Geneticist Alec Jeffreys discovered the technique of DNA fingerprinting, revolutionizing forensic science and modern criminal investigations.

title: Great Kanto Earthquake
description: A devastating earthquake struck the Kanto region of Japan, heavily destroying Tokyo and Yokohama and claiming over 100,000 lives.

title: Live Aid Concert
description: The massive dual-venue Live Aid benefit concert took place in London and Philadelphia to raise funds for Ethiopian famine relief.

title: Enron Bankruptcy
description: Energy giant Enron filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy following a massive accounting scandal, shocking global financial markets.

title: Miracle on Ice
description: The United States men's ice hockey team achieved a shocking upset victory against the heavily favored Soviet Union.

title: Don Quixote Published
description: The first part of Miguel de Cervantes' 'Don Quixote', widely considered the first modern novel, was published in Madrid.

title: First Tweet Sent
description: Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey sent the very first tweet, reading 'just setting up my twttr', launching the microblogging platform.

title: First Spacewalk
description: Soviet cosmonaut Alexei Leonov made history by completing the world's very first extravehicular activity, floating freely in space.

title: End of World War II
description: Representatives from the Empire of Japan formally signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri, officially ending WWII.
